title: The Gap Between Your Best Ideas and Your Next Action Is Bigger Than You Think
note: Render on the Mac: BlogAnnounce.tsx + the cloned voice. Output blog-announce-video.mp4 into this folder.

beats.vo: Your best ideas aren't stalling because they're bad.
They're stalling because the path from idea to action was never built.
Every manual step between strategy and execution is friction — and friction compounds.
Automate the path. Keep humans at the gate for anything that matters.
Start with one workflow, map every step, and build from there.
The full guide is linked in the comments — go build the system.
